reply_text: @marcus.lindqvist The main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Quarrendon Freight Lines' Director of Yard Operations. Dana posted here in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, on the morning shift. In that case a driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch then added him manually, so the same trailer showed up as two rows. Dana had screenshots and was following it up, so she's the person to ask about the latest status on our side.
